prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1036; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, with the mechanism of injury consistent with the reported head trauma. Symptoms at presentation included headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating, and the clinical picture is consistent with a concussion. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly confirm the injury. There is no known prior injury to the head or neck, and the history provided by the patient is consistent across visits. Care was delivered over 27 visits and followed a typical course, with frequency of visits and treatment intensity tapering steadily as symptoms resolved and functional capacity returned. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At the most recent visit the patient reported near-complete resolution of symptoms, and discharge from active care is planned with instructions for return if symptoms recur.
